title: Iraqi Silver Kiddush Cup and Plate
snippet: Iraq, circa 1880, silver covered kiddush cup and plate; this well-known type of Jewish or Iraqi cup is hand wrought, chased, engraved and topped with bird finial Height 5" Provenance: Moriah Galleries, Exhibition of Jewish Folk Art, October 2010, number 178.
